# Badge targets that are allowed not to resolve yet.
#
# `tools/check-badges.py` fails when a *registry* badge (crates.io, PyPI, npm,
# docs.rs) 404s, because that is a promise the README makes to a reader. An
# entry here suppresses that failure until the promise is kept. One URL
# substring per line, `# reason` after the fragment marker.
#
# Keep this list short: an entry here is a debt, and the reason should say what
# makes it acceptable and what removes it.
#
# Example:
#   pypi.org/project/tpt-nrg   # published from the first v0.1.0 tag
